up: Show the exact activity values for compounds tested in assay CHEMBL4649966. For each activity, include the canonical SMILES and the molecule ChEMBL ID. Return all matching activity rows.
sql: SELECT a.activity_id, a.molregno, md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles, a.standard_type, a.standard_relation, a.standard_value, a.standard_units FROM activities a JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4649966';
